name: com.platequery/plate-api
description: License plate lookup and vehicle plate search API for AI agents: check for messages people have posted about a plate and public ALPR (automated license plate reader) sighting history from Flock Safety cameras, by U.S. state or region. OAuth 2.1 (PKCE + dynamic client registration) -- sign in with your PlateQuery account, no manual API key needed.
title: PlateQuery API
